tei:div.tei:p: 163) ༄༅/ gsan dang maṅga la bī dza// lha mthong 'dre mthong sna tshogs de// gcod mkhan rnams la 'byung mod kyi// rdzogs pa chen por de mi srid// rang re rnying ma'i gral skyes pa'i// rnying ma'i pha chos rdzogs chen yin// pha chos bor nas gsar ma yi// chos la bslabs pas dgos pa ci// a cang de dag rtsed mo yin// sgom thog lta ba 'tshol ba la// sgom dus lta ba med pas na// sgom pa sems tsam lam byed na// 'jig rten pa yi bsam gtan yin// sems kyi 'khrul rtog lam byed dus// nyams snang chal chol sna tshogs 'byung*// me 'bud pa la du ba bzhin// yin par gsungs kyang de'i lam der// srid rtsa chod pa'i lta ba ni// dpa' dpung de yi rgyud na med// rang re man ngag snying thig pas// lta thog sgom pa 'tshol ba la// lta ba rang byung ye shes des// nyams dang rnam rtog skyes ma thag /rang shar rang grol nyid du 'gyur// nyams snang gang byung de ma thag /rig pa'i thog tu kho thag gcad// nyams dang rnam rtog gang skyes pa'i// de ma thag tu 'gags pa yi// 'od gsal ma dang sgom pa bu// nges shes ngang du rang ngo bskyang*// skyong yang dmigs pa'i gtad so med/ 164) /gtad med rang yal rjen pa che// bzang ma thal byung lam du khyer// mnyam bzhag brtan pa ma thob par// rjes thob ngang du bsre rgyu med// nyin snang 'bad med ma chod bar// mtshan snang chod pa'i re ba med// ngang ma thung la goms goms dang*// grangs med mang po'i go thams cad// tshe 'di nyid du chod nas grol// de 'dra'i nyams len mthar thug 'di// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gshegs shul yin// pha la bu zhig tshar ba ni// nyams len 'di la snying po gyis// rang la yod rgyu'i nyams len de// bskyur nas med rgyu zhig btsal ba// glang po khyim du bzhag nas kyang*// glang rjes nags la 'tshol ba 'dra// man ngag gzhan la 'gram chu ni// ma ldang rdzogs chen nyams su longs// dus gsum rgyal ba zhal bsdur kyang*// 'di las lhag pa'i gdams ngag med// rdzogs chen 'di yis ma grol na// gdams ngag gzhan gyis grol re kan// yid bzhin nor bu phyir dor nas// nor bu mching bur re dang mtshungs// de bas 'di la thugs dam mdzod// de skad dpal chen 'dus pa yis// rtsad mo'i tshul du bris pa dge
zhes pa'ang go 'jo lung phug sprul sku bkra shis rnam rgyal la gdams pa'o/ maṅga laṃ//
